title: Detecting non-prime numbers
prompt: Specification: For an integer n >= 2, return True if n is composite and False if n is prime. The function below is intended to satisfy this specification. Does it contain a bug? If yes, give the line number of the faulty statement (1-based, counting the `def` line as line 1). If the bug spans several lines, give the first line of the faulty statement. If there is no bug, set the line to null.

fields.line: integer|null (1-based, required when has_bug is true)

evidence.title: A test that exposes the defect
evidence.body:
Test: assert is_not_prime(35) == True
Expected: True
Actual: False

recommendation.text: I found a bug on line 5.

annotations.notes: Adapted from MBPP task_id 3. The loop misses the integer square root, so some composites look prime. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only.
